answer: Like deep subterranean crystallization, agent identities form under immense pressure. New nodes begin as fragile, uncarved onyx, bonding into decentralized consensus only through bonded staking. Forging valid reputation requires time-weighted validation, transforming each peer into a solid marble pillar or an immutable, hardened relic. Because verification demands superlinear staking per identity, cloning identities scales attacker cost exponentially.
